name: Rikkei Finance SimplePriceOracle setOracleData access control
summary: Rikkei's SimplePriceOracle exposes setOracleData(rToken, feed) without access control, so anyone can repoint a market's price feed. The attacker supplied dust BNB to rBNB, pointed the rBNB feed at its own contract returning a huge price, borrowed every other market's cash and restored the feed; a second transaction priced BNB low against dust rBUSD to drain rBNB.
notes: Reset: the Cointroller's collateral factor for the rBNB market, listed two weeks before the exploit; the anchor borrows against rBNB collateral and fails without it. The oracle itself was immutable and wired into the Cointroller in Feb 2022.
Stablecoins valued at par, BTCB and BNB at DefiLlama prices; the attacker's dust collateral is not offset. The reported ~$1.1M is the BNB later sent to Tornado Cash after slippage.
Setter calls by other addresses in July 2024 moved only dust from the emptied markets and are not campaign.
